section_path_text: Saudi Arabia The Kingdom Of Oil
summary:
The influence of the OPEC oil powerhouse is significant
Saudi Arabia is the largest oil producer and most important member of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC). Together with Russia, they largely determine the direction of the cartel. As OPEC's largest producer (and exporter) the actions of the Kingdom have a profound impact on the crude oil tanker market.
